title: The Ferryman
text: A black river, slow and wide, and a ferryman leaning on his pole with his hand out. His face is hidden under a hood. He takes coin, he says, or a memory, whichever is dearer. He does not take no.

options.label: Pay the ferryman in coin, everyone, and keep your memories your own.

outcomes.text: It is a great deal of coin. He counts it slowly with long grey fingers, then counts it again.

options.label: Pay him in memories. Gold is harder to come by out here.

outcomes.text: Everyone forgets something, though no one can say what. Everyone keeps looking for it.

options.label: The hardiest swims a rope across his river, and refuses to pay at all.

outcomes.text: They make it across half drowned, dragging a rope for the rest. The ferryman watches, unsmiling.
The river is not water. It does not want to give them back.
